                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ਹਾਈਡ੍ਰੋਸਟੈਟਿਕ ਪਿੰਜਰ (Hydrostatic Skeleton): ਇਸ ਕਿਸਮ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਸਹਾਰੇ ਅਤੇ ਹਰਕਤ ਲਈ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਤਰਲ ਦੇ ਦਬਾਅ 'ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਗੰਡੋਏ ਵਰਗੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ਬਾਹਰੀ ਪਿੰਜਰ (Exoskeleton): ਕਾਈਟਿਨ ਦਾ ਬਣਿਆ ਇੱਕ ਸਖ਼ਤ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਢੱਕਣ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਕਾਕਰੋਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਰਚਨਾਤਮਕ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਪਿੰਜਰ (Endoskeleton): ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਪਿੰਜਰ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਸੱਪਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਰੀੜ੍ਹ ਦੀ ਹੱਡੀ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਹੱਡੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਬਣੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਗੁੰਝਲਦਾਰ ਹਰਕਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ਹਰਕਤ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਕੂਲਣ (Movement Adaptations): ਜਾਨਵਰਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਾਤਾਵਰਣ ਅਤੇ ਹਰਕਤ ਦੇ ਤਰੀਕਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਕੂਲ ਹੋਣ ਲਈ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਸੰਰਚਨਾਤਮਕ ਅਨੁਕੂਲਣ ਵਿਕਸਿਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਹੱਡੀਆਂ, ਬਾਹਰੀ ਪਿੰਜਰ, ਜਾਂ ਹਾਈਡ੍ਰੋਸਟੈਟਿਕ ਸੰਰਚਨਾਵਾਂ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n11e:T16f5,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is The area under the \\( v-t \\) graph gives acceleration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Velocity is constant and acceleration is zero: When an object moves with uniform velocity, its speed and direction remain constant. As there is no change in velocity, the acceleration is zero. Hence, this statement is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The slope of the line in the \\( v-t \\) graph is zero: In a velocity-time graph for uniform velocity, the slope represents acceleration. Since the velocity remains constant, the slope of the graph is zero. Hence, this statement is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The \\( v-t \\) graph is a horizontal line: For uniform velocity, the velocity does not change over time. Therefore, the velocity-time graph is a horizontal line parallel to the time axis. Hence, this statement is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The area under the \\( v-t \\) graph gives acceleration: The area under the velocity-time graph does not represent acceleration. Instead, it represents the displacement of the object. Acceleration is determined by the slope of the \\( v-t \\) graph. Hence, this statement is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Uniform Velocity:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When an object moves with uniform velocity, its speed and direction remain unchanged throughout its motion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The object covers equal distances in equal intervals of time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In such cases, the acceleration is zero, as there is no change in velocity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Velocity-Time Graph:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The slope of a velocity-time graph represents the acceleration of an object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A horizontal line on the graph indicates constant velocity (zero acceleration).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If the graph is inclined upwards, it indicates positive acceleration; if inclined downwards, it indicates negative acceleration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Area under the \\( v-t \\) Graph:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The area under the velocity-time graph is equal to the displacement of the object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • For example, if a car travels at a constant velocity of 60 m/s for 10 seconds, the displacement is \\( 60 \\times 10 = 600 \\, \\text{m} \\).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Acceleration:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with respect to time, mathematically defined as \\( a = \\frac{\\Delta v}{\\Delta t} \\).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Shortcut Trick

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Semi-perimeter (s) = (37 + 44 + 15) ÷ 2 = 48 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Area using Heron's formula = √[48 × 11 × 4 × 33] = 264 cm2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Altitude on the 44 cm side = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 264) ÷ 44 = 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The sides of the triangle are a = 37 cm, b = 44 cm, and c = 15 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Semi-perimeter, s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Area of triangle = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Area = 1/2 × base × height

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ s = (37 + 44 + 15) ÷ 2 = 96 ÷ 2 = 48 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = √[48 × (48 − 37) × (48 − 44) × (48 − 15)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = √[48 × 11 × 4 × 33]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = √[(16 × 3) × 11 × 4 × (3 × 11)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = √[64 × 9 × 121]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = 8 × 3 × 11 = 264 cm2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Now, substitute the calculated area and the given base (44 cm) into the altitude formula:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 264 = 1/2 × 44 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 264 = 22 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ h = 264 ÷ 22

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ h = 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Heron's Formula

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          It is universally used to calculate the area of any triangle when the lengths of all three sides are known, without needing any altitude or angle. The formula is Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Altitudes of a Triangle

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          An altitude is a perpendicular line segment drawn from a vertex to the opposite side (or its extension). Every triangle has exactly three altitudes, which intersect at a single distinct point called the orthocenter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Relation between Area and Altitude

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Once the area is known, the altitude corresponding to any given base can be easily found using the standard formula: Area = 1/2 × base × height. It is notable that the shortest altitude of a triangle always corresponds to its longest side.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
